# M8 Palette and Squeeze fixture

`grayscale-public-university.jxl` is the unchanged
`grayscale_public_university/input.jxl` decoder conformance fixture from the
[official JPEG XL conformance corpus at revision
`4bf053529c7cefd2951be453475bb3dccc7e7be8`](https://github.com/libjxl/conformance/tree/4bf053529c7cefd2951be453475bb3dccc7e7be8).

The JPEG XL conformance suite describes the source image as authored by Arnold
and Richter Cine Technik GmbH and licensed under [CC Attribution
3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). The source
was converted to grayscale and encoded with lossy compression. This copy is
used to exercise the Modular Palette and Squeeze boundary in the M9 fuzz gate.
